title: Early AI open-world prototype — what would you improve first?
author: Fearless_Shift7108

comments.author: Living_Advice_1225
comments.body: People are overly excited to share premature  versions of their game to the world.

comments.author: nfxdav
comments.body:
First, I would find the game directory that contains all the code, graphics and all other things that the AI made. If you need help with this, ask the AI person that lives in the computer.

Select this directory, this is important now. If you cannot do this, ask the AI person that lives in the computer, he will assist.

The last step \*DO NOT GET THIS WRONG\* press the d-e-l-e-t-e key and move away from the computer machine.
